title: The repeat mark skips a same-thread follow-up and marks only a restated, already-answered ask
why: Owner 14:24 CST Nov 12 (via retrospective): "damn that false repeat mark triggers far too often jesus". Measured in the retrospective today: 35 marks, about 14 false (about 40%), mostly a follow-up to the message just before it on the same topic.
source: owner 14:24 CST Nov 12, relayed by the retrospective 14:25 CST
note: Fix in hooks/feedback_guard.py: the judge skips candidates from the same thread within the last 30 minutes, and marks only an ask that restates an older, already-answered one. Red first on today's false pairs: fb-1419-4 vs 14:16 CST, fb-1422-2 vs 14:19 CST (retrospective inbox). Rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent. Runs at every Stop for every session that logs the owner's words: rank with the stability fixes. Kin: repeat-judge-never-blocks (doing, lane prose-unmapped-4). Lane repeat-mark-fixes (coordinator 14:27 CST Nov 12) holds this and repeat-judge-never-blocks: the same judge in hooks/feedback_guard.py. It first checks the old lane fan-prose-unmapped-4's drafts #2762-#2826 for prior work. Lane default 14:30 CST Nov 12 (non-blocking question to triage): (1) a mechanical skip of same-inbox blocks within 30 min of the item's own block stamp, both directions; (2) the judge prompt adds "a follow-up or detail on the same topic is not a repeat; name a candidate only when the new item asks again for a change it already asked for and got an answer"; no per-source mechanical "answered" filter. Branch stacks on #2781 (repeat-judge-never-blocks, round 3 PASS at 99be21b80, draft, never handed in).
